feladatok.cim: Email to Brian accepting a museum invitation
feladatok.helyzet: You are studying in England and you have received an email from a friend, Brian, with the following advertisement. He would like to see the exhibition and wants you to go with him:

bekezdesek: Horniman Museum, 100 London Road, London, SE23 3PQ This is an exhibition of models of creatures that lived 65 million years ago: a life-sized woolly mammoth, a cat-like animal called smilodon, the bear-like megatherium, the llama-like macrauchenia and a 150 kg bird known as a phorusrhacos.
The exhibition also contains objects from the museum's collection, including the bones of a 10,000-year-old mammoth.

feladatok.teendo: Write an email of 50-80 words in which you accept the invitation and
iranyito_szempontok: ask about the length of the programme and entrance fees,
ask when and where to meet.

feladatok.cim: Letter to Jane about mobile phones at school
feladatok.helyzet: You have received a letter from your English penfriend, Jane, in which she writes the following:

bekezdesek: I have a problem at school. My teachers keep on bugging me for using my mobile in the breaks between lessons. I don't understand why! I always switch off during lessons and I NEVER even TALK, just text my friends. They have told my parents about it and said that I seem to be really addicted. Now my mum insists that I should leave my mobile in my locker for the day and not touch it until after school. I’m desperate! What do you think I should do?

feladatok.teendo: Write a letter of 100-120 words to Jane in which you give your opinion. Include the following:
iranyito_szempontok: why you think the use of mobile phones should or shouldn’t be allowed at school;
whether you think Jane is really addicted to mobile phones;
what you would do if you were Jane.
